items.basis: US list price US$70,995 / 1.3344 = £53,204. List price of the base machine; options, tooling, freight and installation are EXTRA (stated by the source).
items.notes: Third-party index stating the price is 'published by Haas Automation, verified 2026-08-31' (page header dated 2026-09-24). Could not open haascnc.com (blocked) to confirm; Haas's own en-GB/US pages show no UK £ price ('contact your local HFO'). items.basis: Measured mean total power of all consumer groups on a machining centre: 13 kW roughing, 7.4 kW finishing (coolant 5.1 / 1.5 kW of that; compressed air ~1.3 kW). Machine-tool maker's energy-efficiency paper.
items.notes: Cutting-state means, i.e. an UPPER bound for a shift average (which includes idle/load time). Book: mach-vmc3 ≈38.0 kW, mach-vmc5 ≈48.8 kW, DMU 50 ≈43.5 kW, VF-2 ≈22.8 kW, UMC-500 ≈34.8 kW average - 1.7x-6x the measured mean even while roughing. No sourced average for lathes (studies found report only component/cutting shares).

items.basis: Maker's worked example: 6 kW fibre machine ~22 kW average vs 6 kW CO2 ~65 kW, at 65% cutting time over 3,600 h/yr (51,480 vs 152,100 kWh/yr).
items.notes: Vendor figure, not an independent measurement. Book: laser-trumpf-3030 (6 kW fibre) ≈46.4 kW, laser-bystronic-3015 (4 kW) ≈34.8 kW, laser-trumpf-5030 (10 kW) ≈69.7 kW - the 6 kW book figure is ~2.1x the maker's own fibre average and closer to its CO2 figure.

notes: Environment limits: direct page fetches were blocked (DNS/proxy) - every figure comes from search-result text of the cited URL. Re-open each URL before a figure enters the book.

~35 web searches used. Makers (Haas UK, DMG Mori, Mazak, Trumpf, Amada, Bystronic, AIDA, Schuler, Liebherr, Gleason, KUKA) publish no UK £ list prices that the search could reach; 'installed' CAPEX (machine + options + tooling + installation) was not found for any machine.

Confidently wrong in the current book (evidence vs book): (1) mach-haas-vf2 depreciation £38,456/yr vs a US$70,995 (£53.2k) list machine - £38k/yr is ~72% of the whole machine EVERY year; (2) mach-vmc3 £55,660/yr implies ~£557k at 10 yr vs a £30k-55k machine-only market; (3) mach-haas-umc500 £65,780/yr vs ~£126k (2019 UK price); (4) laser-trumpf-3030 £91,080/yr vs a ~£300k-412k estimated new price; (5) robot-mig-cell £75,900/yr vs a £80k-250k UK single-robot cell band; (6) mach-mazak-qt200 £42,504/yr exceeds a used example's €46,500 asking price; (7) power: VMCs 22.8-48.8 kW in the book vs 7.4-13 kW measured mean total while cutting; 6 kW fibre laser 46.4 kW vs the maker's ~22 kW.

Not found: gear machines (all), DMU 50 2026 price, lathes (new), press brakes (only a configuration-wide estimate), presses (new), spot-weld cells, waterjet/plasma/shear (new), maintenance % for machine tools, footprints, UK sheet-metal / press / welding subcontract rates.
Lives given are German BMF AfA tax lives (proxy, labelled); no UK engineering-life source found.
